placements.title: The pipeline supplies a memory's identity when the submitter does not
placements.frame: When a memory arrives without an id, what does the pipeline have to produce, by which route (LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback), and what must still succeed afterward?
placements.why: The position states a condition (no explicit id) and a requirement (generate a slug via LLM id-gen or slugify fallback, then commit). Memory identity generation is a subject later envelopes can keep adding to, such as fallback behavior, collisions and commit guarantees, so it passes the grain test as a theme. The graph is empty, so there is nothing to reuse and the leaf stands as NEW with no lineage or under.

unconnected.why: No existing strata, and this single staging test document does not yet call for a cross-graph grouping. Minting one would be premature sprawl.
